text: You just built the camera that will help sink your company.
The first handheld digital camera. Eight pounds.
A hundred by a hundred pixels. Your phone has a thousand times more.
Twenty-three seconds to save one picture. Time for a nap.
Kodak sold film. Your camera needs none.
Kodak's own 1979 report predicted digital by 2010.
It did make digital cameras. Even No. 1 in the US by 2005.
Film or digital, engineer? Your call.
